concepts.title: OneLake shortcuts
concepts.definition: Reference an existing supported storage target through a OneLake path, rather than maintaining a separate ingestion replica.

concepts.title: Database Mirroring
concepts.definition: Continuously replicate supported operational database data into an analytical representation in OneLake; latency and prerequisites still apply.

concepts.title: Metadata mirroring
concepts.definition: Synchronize metadata and reference underlying source data through shortcuts, instead of replicating the underlying data.

concepts.title: Copy job
concepts.definition: Move data with supported bulk, incremental or CDC delivery and explicit destination and load choices. Source and connector capabilities matter.

concepts.title: OneLake
concepts.definition: The common storage layer and namespace used by Fabric experiences; a storage platform is different from a particular ingestion method.

concepts.title: Delta table
concepts.definition: The table representation used for the mirrored analytical data described in the Fabric mirroring documentation. A file format does not determine an ingestion choice alone.

concepts.title: SQL analytics endpoint
concepts.definition: A SQL query surface for supported table data. In this scope it can query a mirrored database or eligible shortcuts in a lakehouse Tables section.

concepts.title: Identity and permissions
concepts.definition: Access depends on the shortcut path, target path and the applicable passthrough or delegated identity model; do not assume a universal user identity.

semanticEdges.claim: A shortcut references a target; Database Mirroring maintains a replica.
semanticEdges.conditions: Compare reuse of supported existing storage with supported operational-database replication; they are not universally interchangeable.
semanticEdges.rationale: The distinction is reference versus replicated analytical data, not merely a difference in freshness. Metadata mirroring is a different case.
semanticEdges.reviewer: Codex documentation review; not human approval

semanticEdges.claim: Database and metadata mirroring have different data-movement semantics.
semanticEdges.conditions: Database mirroring replicates data; metadata mirroring references underlying data through shortcuts.
semanticEdges.rationale: The word mirroring alone is insufficient to infer a physical replica.
semanticEdges.reviewer: Codex documentation review; not human approval

semanticEdges.conditions: This claim is about metadata mirroring, not all mirroring types.
semanticEdges.rationale: The mechanism exposes source data through references while synchronizing catalog metadata.
semanticEdges.reviewer: Codex documentation review; not human approval

semanticEdges.claim: Mirrored analytical data is represented as Delta tables.
semanticEdges.conditions: Supported Database Mirroring after replication setup; no guarantee of zero latency.
semanticEdges.rationale: The table representation participates in the replication mechanism; this is not a book-containment edge.
semanticEdges.reviewer: Codex documentation review; not human approval

semanticEdges.claim: A mirrored database provides a SQL analytics endpoint.
semanticEdges.conditions: A supported database mirror with configured access; this is an analytics query surface.
semanticEdges.rationale: Fabric creates the SQL endpoint alongside the mirrored database so the replicated tables can be queried.
semanticEdges.reviewer: Codex documentation review; not human approval

semanticEdges.claim: Eligible table shortcuts can be queried through a lakehouse SQL endpoint.
semanticEdges.conditions: The shortcut is in the lakehouse Tables section and targets a supported table format; permissions still apply.
semanticEdges.rationale: A Files shortcut alone is not a promise of automatic SQL table discovery.
semanticEdges.reviewer: Codex documentation review; not human approval

semanticEdges.claim: Authorized identities and permissions govern shortcut access.
semanticEdges.conditions: Check the specific shortcut type and passthrough/delegated model, plus access at the applicable paths.
semanticEdges.rationale: The effective connection identity can differ from the calling user; the shortcut does not grant access automatically.
semanticEdges.reviewer: Codex documentation review; not human approval

semanticEdges.claim: Copy job and Mirroring can both matter in a replication decision.
semanticEdges.conditions: Supported sources and connectors; compare destination, scheduling and incremental/CDC requirements.
semanticEdges.rationale: The official comparison includes continuous replication for both; there is no universal winner based on freshness alone.
semanticEdges.reviewer: Codex documentation review; not human approval

semanticEdges.claim: OneLake provides the storage destination of the mirrored representation.
semanticEdges.conditions: Database mirroring as described in the official overview.
semanticEdges.rationale: This is a functional storage role in replication, not a workspace/chapter membership claim.
semanticEdges.reviewer: Codex documentation review; not human approval
